== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Avernus refers to both a specific [[Territory]] and its [[Incarnation]]. As a [[Territory]], it is characterized by unpredictable temporal fluctuations, where the passage of time can vary significantly compared to the outside world. It is notoriously difficult for [[Travelers]] to navigate with precision, making it a location that is rarely used for traveling. The region is also known as a domain of birds, housing ten thousand different species. The Avernus Incarnation{{!}}Incarnation of Avernus is a distinct entity possessing four unique wings and bronze feathers instead of hair. This being has the ability to locate others within the [[Territory]] regardless of their entry point. Additionally, there is a figure known as [[Grandmaster Avernus]], who holds a leadership position and utilizes fliers to scout wilderness areas.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Avernus is a difficult territory to traverse, characterized as a land of birds where white eagles can be seen diving. Within this region, travelers are known to wear feathered head-wraps as they move through the landscape. The territory is defined by a culture that places a high value on loyalty. It was through this challenging land that [[Alin]] eventually walked.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Avernus is one of the nine Territories and a woman characterized by having two sets of wings. This entity, who is associated with traditional wooden armor and the ability to launch psychic attacks, was suspected by [[Simon]] to be behind Feiora Torannus's mental command. Within her [[Territory]], time moves more slowly than in the outside world, and a Gate can be opened to reach it. Though her power is comparable to [[Lirial]]'s and she was likely involved in the prophecy, Avernus has been sealed back into her domain where guards remain on the other side.}}
